description: Make one short video (about 3–15 s) and save it to a BrandBrain studio project. Paid only by your own or your workspace's OpenRouter or Gemini key; BrandBrain's key never pays for video. Pass max_cost_usd, the most the user agreed to spend. model 'auto' follows your selection: by default 'recommended' (established models, your own key first), or cheapest or best, within it. first_frame starts from an image_id. Returns within about 20 s; videos take 1–6 minutes, so then call get_video with the project_id and video_id. Repeating an identical call never pays twice; pass variation for a new video.

audio.description: Generate sound. Defaults to on where the model can; some models are always silent or always have sound.

duration_seconds.description: The model's default (usually 8 s) when omitted; each model allows only some lengths.

first_frame.description: An image_id (from get_generation, list_images or get_image) to start the video from.

max_cost_usd.description: Most you will pay for this video in USD. Tell the user first; they approve it. If the price is higher nothing is charged and the reply says what it would cost.

model.description: 'auto' follows your selection: by default 'recommended' (established models, your own key first), or cheapest or best, within max_cost_usd. Or 'provider/model' from list_video_models, e.g. 'openrouter/google/veo-3.1-lite' or 'gemini/gemini-omni-1.2-flash'.

pay_with.description: auto, personal, workspace, own, or a key_id from list_provider_keys. BrandBrain's key never pays for video. A named payer never falls back.

project_id.description: Add to an earlier agent-made project instead of starting one.

prompt.description: What happens in the video, as you'd brief a director: subject, motion, camera, sound.

selection.description: With model 'auto': how it picks (strategy, prefer, exclude). Ignored when model names a model.

exclude.description: Exact ids, or prefixes ending in '*' (e.g. 'openrouter/*'), that are never picked. Applies before prefer.

prefer.description: Exact model ids to try first, in order, e.g. 'openrouter/google/veo-3.1-lite'. Any class may be named, including legacy and experimental ones. For images an id the catalogue doesn't list is refused (model_unknown); for video an id that isn't offered is skipped. An id must not repeat.

strategy.description: recommended (the default): the recommended model that fits, paid by your own key first, then the workspace's, then BrandBrain's key; then fixed-price models before metered ones, then price. cheapest: the lowest price. best: the cheapest premium model that fits, then standard, then budget.

variation.description: Change (2, 3, ...) to get a new video for an otherwise identical request.

workspace_id.description: Required when you belong to several workspaces; ask the user.

name: generate_video
title: Generate video (paid, your own key)
